title: Page 4
content_zh:
原嘉宁却道：「给我准备披风，我要去见母亲。」

在两人为她整装时，原嘉宁又说：「其实太子殿下的婚事，决定权最终还是在皇上手里吧？我虽无意做什么太子妃，但是冰莹也绝不会中选的。」

「啊？真的？小姐，你怎么能这么确定？」锦心对这个消息大感兴趣。

「因为皇上绝对不会让薛家连出两代皇后啊。」原嘉宁轻松地说，随即狡黯地笑了笑，「冰莹是人在局中看不清，以后有得她哭呢。」

锦英拍手道：「那就最好了，皇上最英明！要奴婢说呀，皇上让谁做太子妃都好，就是不要选薛大小姐，就她那德行，一点都没有未来国母的风范嘛。」

「好了，这个话题到此为止。」原嘉宁适时制止了两个丫鬟。

原嘉宁带领着丫头走进母亲院落时，云青萝刚处埋完家务事，正坐在花厅里喝茶休息。

「娘。」原嘉宁走到云青萝身边，紧挨着她坐下，心里的委屈一下子就爆发了出来，忍不住泪盈眼眶。

虽然云青萝向来对子女不特别宠溺，表情也多是淡淡的，原嘉宁却非常尊敬母亲，认为她才是这个家里真正的支柱，从来就没有母亲解决不了的事，而且她也从来不会让自己的子女真正吃亏受气。

「怎么了？」云青萝倒是有点惊讶，她同样了解自己的长女，虽然性格温婉，实则相当坚强，不会轻易掉泪的。

「娘，我都到了及笄之年，为什么还没有订亲？」原嘉宁开门见山地问。

这话她其实己忍了很久了，时下大多数的女孩子十三岁就开始议亲，到了十五六岁就会正式完婚了，像她这样连订亲都没有的，还真的不多。

刚才她一本正经对薛冰莹说母亲已经为自己择了一门亲事，其实只是硬撑场面胡说罢了。

云青萝扬了扬眉毛，放下手中的细瓷茶杯，细细打量着已经要比自己还略高几分的闺女。嘉宁遗传了自己的样貌，又继承了她父亲那种清雅内敛的气质，不是云青萝这个做母亲的自夸，她的女儿绝对是万中难挑其一的绝佳女子。

云青萝微笑道：「怎么？这么快就想着嫁人了？」

「娘！」原嘉宁拽住云青萝的袖子，用力摇了摇，「我问您正经的呢。」

云青萝叹了口气，难得爱怜地抚摸着自家闺女幼嫩光滑的脸颊，说：「你是听到什么风声了吧？太子的事？」

原嘉宁郁闷地「嗯」了一声，「刚才薛冰莹来了，笑话了女儿一顿。」

云青萝的手停在了女儿的餐角，嘴角微扬，说：「薛珍那么沉稳的人，她的侄女却那么沉不住气。不过，宁宁，你老实告诉娘，真的不愿意嫁给太子吗？」

原嘉宁咬了咬嘴唇，有点困惑地反问道：「娘，在女儿的心里，一直把他看做弟弟，怎么会有儿女私情？我如果嫁了他，那该有多别扭啊？难道你和爹爹也真的打算把我嫁给他，所以才一直没有为我议亲吗？」

云青萝微微叹了口气，「如果你一定得嫁给他呢？毕竟你们并不是真正的姐弟。」

原嘉宁皱紧了眉头，好久才说：「我不想嫁。」

「为什么？」云青萝追问。

「先不说我们之间曾经是姐弟这样尴尬的身分，就算不提这个，现在嫁了他做太子妃，就算以后成为皇后又怎样？皇帝后宫里三宫六院的，嫔妃那么多，皇后还不是要与众多女人争夺那一丁点宠爱？我想嫁个对我一心一意的好夫君，快快乐乐的过自己的日子，就像你和爹爹一样。我才不要去为他做后宫总管，去管他那些未来的莺莺燕燕，和将来更多的庶子庶女呢。」原嘉宁说。

云青萝忍不住微笑，她生养的女儿果然不是那种羡慕浮华之辈，这让她倍感欣慰，但是也很忧心。这世上的好男人其实真的很少，能够对妻子一心一意的就更少，她到哪里去挑选一个这样的好女婿？

其实这些年云青萝一直在留意京城中的众多适龄少年，但是这些男孩子在她眼里总是有这样那样的缺点，让她无法将女儿放心地交出去。

而且皇帝玄昱也早早就放下了话，为玄渊预定了原嘉宁为妻，云青萝就算再胆大妄为，也不敢不听皇帝的命令，这才是最让她和原修之难为的地方。

玄昱之所以选定原嘉宁，是因为看重原府的势力，玄渊出身有问题，做了太子也地位不稳，需要有原府这样强势的外戚来撑腰，这一点原修之夫妻都看得很明白。

虽然玄渊出身原府，注定了和原府牵扯不断的关系，但是这种关系远没有成为姻亲来得更牢靠。

原嘉宁见母亲久久沉吟不语，不由焦急地问：「是不是皇上非要我嫁给太子？娘，咱们能不能拒绝啊？玄渊连『娶谁都好，就是不娶原嘉宁』这样难听的话都说出来了！他看不上我，我还看不上他呢！」

云青萝拍了拍女儿的手，说：「我回头和你爹商量商量，放心吧，女儿，娘绝对不会让你受这个闷气的，那个混帐小子，以为他成了太子就了不起了？给我等着！」

皇帝的指婚之后就没了后续，原嘉宁烦躁不安的心便稍微放了下来。

眨眼就到了春节，喧嚣忙碌过后，紧接着是更热闹的元宵节，对于全城的女眷们来说，元宵节才是重头戏，是难得可以出去尽兴游玩的日子。

原嘉宁今年心事重重，原本没有兴致外出游玩，但是耐不住弟弟妹妹的怂恿劝说，最后也不得不跟着出门。

元宵节看花灯，为了要能领略到那份独特的欢快和热闹，众人都是步行。金陵这些年来一直太平，所以格外繁华热闹，大街上人群众多，众位女眷玩了一会儿，就有点累了，决定找个清静点的茶楼歇歇脚。

半墨茶楼是一栋以针对富家子弟为主的茶楼，楼下大厅的最低吃食消费就要一两银子，这比普通百姓一月的辛苦酬劳都还要高，他们自然消费不起，也不敢进门，所以茶楼里相对清静许多。

原嘉宁一行人直接上了二楼的雅间，这里人更少，更加清静，也方便推开窗子观赏远处的花灯和街景。

众人坐下喝茶休息，走得酸疼的脚总算舒服了一些，可还没安稳片刻，么妹原嘉敏就蹭到原嘉宁的身边，小声道：「姐姐，我想去茅厕。」

原嘉敏今年才七岁，小脸蛋粉嫩嫩圆嘟嘟的还带着婴儿肥，大眼睛乌溜溜地看着自己最信赖的大姐姐。

原嘉宁只好起身，亲自携着原嘉敏的小手到外间去寻找茅厕，锦心和锦英也跟了出来。

锦英招来小二哥，询问茅厕在哪，小二哥立即为她们指明了方向，二楼就有专门为贵客准备的如厕间。

锦心跟着原嘉敏进去如厕，原嘉宁和锦英在外面等候，这时突然走过来一个人，伸手拉住了原嘉宁的手，将她迅速拉入了相隔几步之外的雅间之中。

变故不过发生在眨眼之间，等锦英反应过来要大叫时，已经有人伸手捂住了她的嘴巴，低声喝道：「太子殿下请原小姐过去一叙，不要声张！」

其实锦英也认出了把小姐掠走的人正是玄渊，她想去报信给自家二少爷三少爷，却被玄渊带来的侍卫给押住，只能不满地瞪着侍卫生闷气。

被玄渊拉到雅间里的原嘉宁狠狠地甩开了他的手，怒道：「你这是做什么？强抢民女吗？」
content_en:
Yuan Jianing said, "Prepare a cloak for me, I'm going to see my mother."

While the two were dressing her up, Yuan Jianing added, "Actually, the final decision on His Royal Highness's marriage is in the hands of the Emperor, right? Although I have no intention of becoming a Crown Princess, Bingying will never be chosen."

"Ah? Really? Miss, how can you be so sure?" Jin Xin was very interested in the news.

"Because the emperor will never let the Xue family have two queens in a row." Yuan Jianing said easily, and then smiled slyly, "Bingying is a person who cannot see clearly in the game. I will make her cry in the future."

Jinying clapped her hands and said, "That's the best, the emperor is the wisest! I want you to tell me, whoever the emperor wants to be the crown princess is fine. Just don't choose Miss Xue. With her virtues, she doesn't have the demeanor of the future mother of the country at all."

"Okay, this topic is over." Yuan Jianing stopped the two maids at the right time.

When Yuan Jianing led the girl into her mother's courtyard, Yun Qingluo had just finished her housework and was sitting in the flower hall drinking tea and resting.

"Mom." Yuan Jianing walked to Yun Qingluo and sat down next to her. The grievances in her heart suddenly burst out, and she couldn't help but burst into tears.

Although Yun Qingluo has never been particularly doting on her children and her expressions are mostly indifferent, Yuan Jianing respects her mother very much and believes that she is the real pillar of the family. There is never anything that her mother cannot solve, and she never lets her children really suffer.

"What's wrong?" Yun Qingluo was a little surprised. She also knew her eldest daughter. Although she had a gentle personality, she was actually quite strong and would not shed tears easily.

"Mom, I'm already in my prime, why haven't I gotten engaged yet?" Yuan Jianing asked straight to the point.

She has actually been saying this for a long time. Nowadays, most girls start discussing marriage at the age of thirteen, and will officially get married when they are fifteen or sixteen. There are not many like her who don't even have an engagement.

Just now she told Xue Bingying seriously that her mother had already chosen a marriage for her, but in fact it was just nonsense to hold up the scene.

Yun Qingluo raised her eyebrows, put down the fine porcelain tea cup in her hand, and looked carefully at her daughter, who was already slightly taller than herself.Jianing inherited her own appearance and her father's elegant and restrained temperament. Yun Qingluo, as a mother, is not one to boast, but her daughter is definitely one of the best women in a million.

Yun Qingluo smiled and said, "What? Are you thinking of getting married so soon?"

"Mom!" Yuan Jianing grabbed Yun Qingluo's sleeve and shook it hard, "I'm asking you for a serious question."

Yun Qingluo sighed, caressed her daughter's young and smooth cheek with rare tenderness, and said, "Did you hear something? About the prince?"

Yuan Jianing said "Yeah" depressedly, "Xue Bingying came just now and laughed at my daughter."

Yun Qingluo's hand stopped at the corner of her daughter's table, her lips raised slightly, and she said, "Xue Zhen is such a calm person, but her niece is so restless. But, Ning Ning, tell me honestly, are you really not willing to marry the prince?"

Yuan Jianing bit her lip and asked in confusion: "Mom, in my daughter's heart, she has always regarded him as her younger brother. How could there be an affair? If I married him, how awkward would it be? Are you and dad really planning to marry me to him, so that's why you haven't discussed marriage for me?"

Yun Qingluo sighed slightly, "What if you have to marry him? After all, you are not real siblings."

Yuan Jianing frowned and said for a long time, "I don't want to get married."

"Why?" Yun Qingluo asked.

"Let's not talk about the embarrassing status of brother and sister between us. Even if we don't mention this, what if we marry him as the crown princess now, even if we become the queen in the future? There are so many concubines in the emperor's harem, so the queen still has to compete with many women for her daughter."A little pampering? I want to marry a good husband who is devoted to me and live my life happily, just like you and dad. I don't want to be the steward of his harem and take care of his future bastards and concubines," Yuan Jianing said.

Yun Qingluo couldn't help but smile. The daughter she gave birth to was indeed not the kind of person who envied flashy people. This made her feel happy, but also worried.There are actually very few good men in this world, and even fewer who can be devoted to their wives. Where can she choose such a good son-in-law?

In fact, Yun Qingluo has been paying attention to many school-age boys in the capital over the years, but these boys always have shortcomings in her eyes, which makes her unable to hand over her daughter with confidence.

Moreover, Emperor Xuan Yu also put down his words early and arranged for Yuan Jianing to be Xuan Yuan's wife. No matter how daring Yun Qingluo acted, she would not dare to disobey the emperor's orders. This was what made it most difficult for her and Yuan Xiuzhi.

The reason why Xuan Yu chose Yuan Jianing was because he valued the power of Yuan Mansion. Xuan Yuan's background was problematic, and his status as prince was unstable. He needed the support of a strong relative like Yuan Mansion. Both Yuan Xiu and his wife understood this clearly.

Although Xuan Yuan was born in the Yuan Mansion, he was destined to have a constant relationship with the Yuan Mansion, but this relationship was far less solid than becoming an in-law.

Seeing that her mother was silent for a long time, Yuan Jianing couldn't help but asked anxiously: "Does the emperor insist that I marry the prince? Mother, can we refuse? Xuan Yuan even said such ugly words as 'I can marry anyone, but not Yuan Jianing'! He doesn't like me, and I don't like him!"

Yun Qingluo patted her daughter's hand and said, "I'll discuss it with your father later. Don't worry, daughter, my mother will never let you suffer like this. That bastard, does he think he is great because he becomes the prince? Just wait for me!"

After the emperor's engagement, there was no follow-up, and Yuan Jianing's restless heart relaxed a little.

The Spring Festival is here in the blink of an eye. After the hustle and bustle, the even more lively Lantern Festival comes. For the women in the city, the Lantern Festival is the highlight and it is a rare day to go out and have fun.

Yuan Jianing was very preoccupied this year and had no interest in going out for fun at first, but couldn't bear the encouragement and persuasion of his younger siblings and finally had to follow him out.

During the Lantern Festival, everyone walks to watch the lanterns in order to appreciate the unique joy and bustle.Jinling has been peaceful over the years, so it is particularly prosperous and lively. There are many people on the street. After playing for a while, the female relatives got a little tired and decided to find a quieter teahouse to rest.

Banmo Tea House is a tea house mainly for children from rich families. The minimum food consumption in the downstairs hall is one or two silver, which is higher than ordinary people's hard work for a month. Naturally, they cannot afford it and dare not come in, so the tea house is relatively quiet.

Yuan Jianing and his party went directly to the private room on the second floor. There were fewer people here and it was quieter. It was also convenient to open the window and enjoy the lanterns and street views in the distance.

Everyone sat down to drink tea and rest. Their sore feet finally felt better after walking. But before they had settled down for a moment, Yuan Jiamin, the younger sister, brushed up against Yuan Jianing and whispered, "Sister, I want to go to the toilet."

Yuan Jiamin is only seven years old this year. She has a pink and round face with baby fat, and her big eyes look at her most trusted big sister.

Yuan Jianing had no choice but to get up and personally took Yuan Jiamin's little hand to the outside to find the toilet. Jinxin and Jinying also followed them out.

Jinying called the second brother and asked where the toilet was. The second brother immediately pointed out the direction for them. There was a toilet room specially prepared for distinguished guests on the second floor.

Jin Xin followed Yuan Jiamin into the toilet, while Yuan Jianing and Jinying were waiting outside. Suddenly a man came over, reached out and took Yuan Jianing's hand, and quickly pulled her into the private room a few steps away.

The incident only happened in the blink of an eye. By the time Jinying reacted and was about to scream, someone had already reached out and covered her mouth, shouting in a low voice: "Your Highness, please come over and talk to Miss Yuan. Don't make any noise!"

In fact, Jinying also recognized that the person who kidnapped the young lady was Xuan Yuan. She wanted to report the news to her second and third young masters, but was detained by the guards brought by Xuan Yuan. She could only stare at the guards with dissatisfaction and sulk.

Yuan Jianing, who was pulled into the private room by Xuan Yuan, shook his hand away and said angrily: "What are you doing? Are you robbing a civilian girl?"
